name: frontend-build-deps
body: For every frontend, the spec names the dependencies that must be present when its artifact is compiled: the compiler/toolchain and its minimum version, the package manager or dependency-resolution mechanism, and whether network access is required to resolve dependency artifacts. Acceptance: the set is checkable against the build recipe (`build.rs` and/or the split formula) — every command the build runs is attributable to a named dependency. Known build-time deps: Go needs Go ≥ 1.25 (`src/golib/go.mod` declares `go 1.25.0`) plus network for `golang.org/x/tools v0.48.0`; Java needs `javac` with `--release 21`; C++ needs `gcc`/`g++` (`-std=c11` runtime/grammar, `-std=c++17` scanner); Rust needs a stable Rust toolchain plus network for the git-pinned rust-analyzer crates; TS needs `node` + `npm ci`; C# needs a .NET SDK plus NuGet; Python needs Rust + network for the git-pinned Ruff/ty crates; Markdown needs Rust + crates.io; the base scanner needs Rust plus the prebuilt static liblbug and links OpenSSL (`openssl@3` / `libssl.so.3`).
